rate_fields.provider: Provider id, e.g. openai or deepseek
rate_fields.model_id: Exact billed model id; must match the config provider.model_id
rate_fields.reasoning_usd_per_million: Optional separate reasoning rate. Omit when reasoning_billed_as is output.
rate_fields.reasoning_billed_as: output means reasoning tokens are included in completion/output tokens and billed at the output rate. Do not add a second reasoning charge.
rate_fields.cached_input_usd_per_million: Verified cached input token price when the API reports cached tokens
rate_fields.billing_window: peak | off-peak | flat. Catalog DeepSeek rows are official peak rates used as conservative estimates.

notes: USD totals are computed after a call from reported tokens and a matching catalog rate. Missing tokens or missing rates stay unknown; nothing is imputed.
Catalog USD is a catalog_token_estimate. It is not a provider invoice or a confirmed charge.
max_estimated_budget_usd is a post-call estimated-spend stop, not a guaranteed pre-call cap. A single request can still exceed the budget. Unknown usage on any completed call blocks later calls.
Use max_requests as the hard pre-call limit. EL configs set max_estimated_budget_usd to 1.00.
OpenAI GPT-5 and GPT-6 family reasoning tokens are billed as output tokens. Catalog rows use reasoning_billed_as=output so the runner does not double-count them.

GPT-6 Luna official Standard rates (short context): input 0.10, cached input 0.01, output 0.50 USD per 1M tokens. Cache writes (0.125) are not a separate runner line; they are not mapped from usage today.
DeepSeek reasoning tokens, when present, are treated as output-billed (do not double-count).
DeepSeek rates are official peak USD (weekdays 01:00–04:00 and 06:00–10:00 UTC, excluding Chinese holidays). Off-peak list prices are half; actual invoices may be lower than these estimates.
Only operator-verified official rates are listed. Other providers remain unpriced.
